data.name: Bashaar
data.gender_notes: Bashaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who conquers or subdues. One who is victorious and triumphant. The name Bashaar carries the meaning “Conqueror, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bashaar usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner strength and courage to overcome obstacles and challenges in life.
data.etymology: Bashaar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bashaar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
